scenes.headline: PyTorch 2.15: what changed, and what a CPU can check
scenes.sub: The NCCL rewrite becomes the default; two wheels compared side by side.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bellows! PyTorch 2.15 is out. I compared its wheel with the one before, and I'll show what a plain CPU box can actually confirm.

scenes.label: The big change
scenes.text: Every process group asking for nccl now gets the rewritten backend by default, with two ways back to the legacy one.
scenes.say: The big change: every process group that asks for nccl now gets the rewritten backend by default, with two ways back to the old one.

scenes.title: How a group picks its backend

steps.say: A job starts a process group and asks for the nccl backend.
In this release that request resolves to the rewritten backend, which was only an opt-in preview before.
Setting the environment variable to zero, or asking for nccl-legacy by name, brings the old backend back.
The new backend also feeds a flight recorder that writes a post-mortem to disk when a collective hangs.

scenes.title: Fourteen probes, two wheels
scenes.note: the untestable one is the NCCL default itself
scenes.say: Ten surfaces are visibly new in the wheel, three behave identically, and one cannot be tested without GPUs. That one is the NCCL default.

items.say: Run one representative job with the rollback variable set, and one without.
Diff the logs. Communicators are created with the group now, so failures surface earlier.
If you use the second generation of fully sharded training, read the gradient dtype note, because a default moves.

scenes.label: of the release's commits are named in the blog
scenes.note: 108 cited pull requests out of 3,117 commits
scenes.say: The blog names about three and a half percent of the release's commits, so the list is a selection, not the whole release.

scenes.text: The default switch is the change to test first: it is the only one that alters a job you already run.

recap: nccl now means the rewritten backend
Ten new surfaces confirmed on the wheel
Test one job each way before you upgrade
scenes.say: To recap: nccl now means the rewritten backend, ten new surfaces are confirmed in the wheel, and you should test one job each way before upgrading.
